whenToUse: Short status, count or tag labels: Draft, Overdue, 12, VIP.
Removable chips in custom filter or tag UIs.
avoidWhen: Changing a record's status inline — use Status picker.
Long sentences — use Alert or text.
a11y: Never convey meaning by colour alone; the text carries the status.
Count badges on icons need an accessible label (3 unread notifications).
